text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 vaccines have significantly impacted public health by reducing hospitalizations and severe illness, especially among older adults. While protection from vaccination wanes over time, the vaccines offer substantial benefits, particularly during the first few months after vaccination. Common side effects are usually mild and manageable.

list.title: Reduced Hospitalizations:

list.title: Protection Wanes:
list.snippet: Protection from vaccination decreases over time, with a noticeable decline in effectiveness around 4-6 months after vaccination.
